newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil real off, market awaits mini-band drop.
newsitem.headline: Brazil real off, market awaits mini-band drop.

text.p: Brazil's real dropped 0.02 percent to close at 1.0393 against the dollar in the commercial foreign exchange market, with players awaiting a new lowering of the real-dollar mini-band, dealers said.
The current mini-band was fixed by the Central Bank on Tuesday between 1.0390 and 1.0440 reais per dollar.
Some banks had expected a Central Bank move today, but now the market is looking for a lower mini-band on Monday.

"Over the last few months, the Central Bank has mostly lowered the mini-band at the beginning of the month. Because of the holidays, the market believes that next Monday will start this month," one trader said.
In the interbank forex floating rate market, the real closed at 1.0448 to the dollar, down 0.01 percent.
In the illegal parallel market, the real closed flat at 1.120 per greenback.
